title: Personal two-call synthetic context-cost batch approval input; no live egress grant
description: The immutable enablement must select schema 0.3.0 and the ADR-0014 context-cost policy; client fields cannot select or upgrade policy. Exactly one explanation and one PR summary template are checked server-side. Approval creates metadata only. Each attempt reserves 316373 microUSD; two serial attempts require 632746..700000 authorized microUSD, stop on any failure, no retries or extra requests. All independent runtime/technical gates remain required.

enablementId.description: Must bind an immutable 0.3.0 context-policy acknowledgement; an old enablement cannot be upgraded by this body.

syntheticInventoryId.description: Trusted deployment inventory must review this exact Project and computed manifest. Caller consent and digest matching do not prove synthetic provenance.

templateRequestIds.description: Server validates exactly one FINDING_EXPLANATION and one PR_SUMMARY template; no extra attempts or automatic retries.

manifestSha256.description: Must equal server digest of ordered immutable templates, resource bindings and input/citation hashes.

expiresAt.description: Future, at most 24 hours; not later than acknowledgement, price or operator inventory expiry.

maxCostMicrousd.description: At least two context reservations, at most the owner's USD 0.70 conditional authorization. Local control based on declared context and peak prices, not a provider account spending guarantee.
